name: meal_phase_simple_v1
description: Meal phase agent evaluation - phase-specific nutrition planning

inputs.meal_plan_description: Mediterranean-style nutrition plan for muscle building with emphasis on whole foods

expectations.expected_behavior: Generate phase-specific meal plan with 4 meals/day for pescatarian with no dairy. Foundation phase should use maintenance calories (calorie_goal_modifier: 1.0). Include 2 sample days (training + rest). Must include grocery list with categories and shopping schedule. Must include meal prep sessions with instructions and prep schedule. All schedules use target_day_name format. Use percentage-based schema (calorie_goal_modifier, macro_split_*_percent, calorie_percentage for meals/foods).

inputs.meal_plan_description: High-protein meal plan for hypertrophy with calorie surplus

expectations.expected_behavior: Generate hypertrophy phase meal plan with 5 meals/day. Should use calorie surplus modifier (1.1-1.2 for 10-20% surplus). High protein (35-40% of calories). Include pre/post workout nutrition. Must include complete grocery shopping and meal prep schedules with explicit day names and repeat patterns. Use percentage-based schema (calorie_goal_modifier, macro_split_*_percent fields, calorie_percentage for meals/foods - all must sum to 100%).
expectations.calorie_goal_modifier_description: Calorie surplus for muscle building (10-20% above TDEE)
